mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 5d forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5% and employment growth (PAYEMS) is above 0.5% monthly, it signals a tight labor market, leading to wage pressures and inflation, which triggers equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising), a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals an overheating economy, leading to recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is rising (3-month change > 0) and UNRATE < 3.5%, 60d forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively related to economic activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST level does not produce significantly positive 60d returns (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is a leading indicator of economic health; higher INDPRO signals strong supply conditions, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level does not produce significantly positive 60d returns (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1300, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300, it signals a simultaneous contraction in supply and demand, leading to recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1300, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
